metadata.subject: Human Resource Development and Organizational Behavior

instructions: The marks are indicated in the right-hand margin.
There are NINE questions in this paper.

sections.section_title:
Q.1 Choose the correct answer of the following (any seven question
                    only):

questions.text: Which of the following is NOT a function of Human Resource Management?
Which of the following is NOT a common method of performance appraisal?
Which of the following is an example of intrinsic motivation?
options: Feeling a sense of accomplishment from completing a challenging task

questions.text: Aligning the goals and culture of an organization with the personal goals of employees is called:
Which of the following leadership styles focuses on rewarding employees for goals achievement?

The theory of motivation that focuses on the idea of employees comparing their inputs and outputs
                        relative to others is called?
Which of the following is NOT a part of HR planning?
Which method is used in job evaluation?
What is the primary goal of job analysis?
options: To determine job roles and responsibilities
To determine job roles and responsibilities

questions.text: The process of handling disagreements in an organization is referred to as:
